subject: Invoice delivery: portal opt‑in + handling PO exceptions
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@covehealth.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@covehealth.com, carlos.mendez@covehealth.com
Date: 2028-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice delivery options and PO handling for Redwood services

Hi Avery,

Quick note from our AP side — we want to onboard Redwood to our vendor portal (Coupa) for automated invoice ingestion. Before we proceed, two questions: 1) Can you deliver consolidated invoices by "bill-to" entity (we have three legal entities that purchase separately), and 2) How do you handle POs for exception cases when a PO is issued after the month close? Our standard is that the PO number must be populated on the invoice PDF or XML for auto-apply.

If portal launch will block certain one-off invoices (credits, retro adjustments, or partner pass-throughs), we need a fallback (manual push to ap@covehealth.com) for those. Also confirm whether we can receive daily invoice pushes via SFTP if Coupa mapping proves brittle initial week.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Soto
Director, Accounts Payable
Cove Health

[attachment: vendor-onboarding-form.pdf (stub)]

From: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@covehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and PO handling for Redwood services

Hi Elena — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can support both portal-first delivery and manual pushes for exceptions, and we can deliver consolidated invoices per legal entity.

Plan proposal (quick MAP):
- Phase 1 (Portal opt-in): Redwood will send individual invoices to your Coupa endpoint. Invoices will include an "entity_code" header so your mapping can route to the correct legal entity.
- Phase 2 (Exception flow): For any invoice types that Coupa can't accept (credits, retro adjustments, late POs), we will push a PDF/XML to ap@covehealth.com and tag the subject with "COH-EXC" + invoice_id so your AP team can ingest manually.
- Phase 3 (Fallback automation): If mapping issues persist in week 1, we can enable a daily SFTP push (encrypted) of that day's invoice bundle.

Questions for you to confirm so we can finalize:
1) Confirm the three legal entity codes and preferred invoice grouping (monthly consolidated per-entity or weekly).
2) Confirm the exact PO field label your mapping requires (PO, PO# or PurchaseOrderNumber).
3) Are you able to accept the sample XML schema I attached for testing?

I'm copying Ben from Billing to align on the invoice XML and Marissa from Contracts for any PO/T&Cs that need mention. I'll stand up a short 30-minute call today if you prefer to walk through the mapping live.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

[attachment: redwood-invoice-sample-entity-mapping.xml (stub)]

From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@covehealth.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@covehealth.com>, ap@covehealth.com
Date: 2028-06-20T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and PO handling for Redwood services

Avery — thanks for the quick response. A few clarifications from AP: 
- Our legal entities and preferred grouping: COH-NY (monthly), COH-CA (monthly), COH-UK (monthly, includes VAT). We want consolidated monthly per-entity.
- PO field: we need either "PO" or "PO#". Ideally both if you can populate them.
- We can accept XML schema for testing, but the portal often drops line-level tax tags; for COH-UK we need VAT breakdown at the invoice-level and line-level if available.

Regarding exceptions: we sometimes receive a PO after month close (for retro accruals). For those, we require the invoice to be re-issued with the PO number and clearly flagged as "post-close PO" so AP can route to accrual clearing. Can Redwood support a re-issue flow and a re-numbered invoice ID?

If possible, we'd like Redwood to send a test batch this week to our Coupa sandbox and simultaneously post the same files to ap@covehealth.com with the subject line: "COH TEST - Redwood Invoices". That will help us compare processing.

Carlos
Vendor Onboarding, Cove Health

[attachment: covehealth-po-exception-template.xlsx (stub)]

From: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@covehealth.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@covehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-20T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and PO handling for Redwood services

Thanks Carlos / Elena — we can support everything you outlined. Next steps and owners: 

1) Redwood (Ben) to send test payloads to Coupa sandbox + a copy to ap@covehealth.com today (Ben: will include VAT line-level and entity_code).
2) Cove Health to confirm sandbox endpoint and entity mapping table (Elena: please share mapping by EOD).
3) For post-close PO re-issues: Redwood can re-issue invoices with a new invoice_id and a header "X-Original-Invoice: <old_id>" and the reason code "post-close PO". That will be in our billing playbook; Marissa will note contractual acceptance if you need it to show on record.
4) Fallbacks: SFTP daily push will remain off by default; we will enable it if the sandbox week shows >2% mapping failures.

Ben, please send the test bundle (Coupa XML + PDF) and confirm SFTP details if we need to enable it. Marissa, flag anything on the contract side for post-close credit handling.

Avery
